en.t: You look terribly lonely to me.

units.source_text: 有时望着，总觉得实在受不了。

en.t: Sometimes when I look at you, I feel I really cannot bear it.

units.source_text: 总觉得你孤身只影，太寂寞了。

en.t: I keep feeling that you are all alone, with only your shadow, and far too lonely.
Your shadow is misshapen, you know.
It is the shadow of your heart.

units.source_text: 从小时候起，境遇就不好。

en.t: Ever since childhood, your circumstances have been unfortunate.

units.source_text: 是学生又有什么关系呢，结婚吧。

en.t: What does it matter that you are a student? Get married.
Otherwise there will be no way to save you.

units.source_text: 我来关照你，能给你出学费，让你成立家庭，保证你的生活的，前来我医院看病的患者之中有的是。

en.t: I will look after you; among the patients who come to my clinic there are plenty who can pay your tuition, let you establish a family, and guarantee your livelihood.

units.source_text: 总觉得影子是畸形的啊，影子。”

en.t: I keep feeling that the shadow is misshapen, that shadow.
